slot: Korch picks 13th (last) in every odd round and 1st in every even round; the keeper round also runs in draft order, so with no keeper the first three picks are back-to-back (keeper-round #13, R1 #13, R2 #14). Later pairs: 39/40, 65/66, 91/92, 117/118, 143/144, 169/170.
keeper_reasoning: No keeper wins in the simulation (157.5 vs 152.9 keeping the Avalanche, 152.1 Indiana, 151.5 Guyana; sd ~3). Keeping uses the keeper-round pick on a player you could replace later; not keeping turns it into a free pick at #13, right before your R1/R2 turn.

The Avalanche slid to 12.3 (4th in NHL) behind the Hurricanes 13.9, Lightning 13.4 and Oilers 13.1 (Oct 22 refresh). The sim now has Jamzee keeping Carolina and Fryar keeping Tampa Bay, so NHL thins out, but Golden Knights 10.8, Panthers 11.7 (Todd keeps Rodrigo) and Wild 10.6 still last to about R5. Keeping Colorado costs ~4.6 pts vs a free premium pick.

Guyana is no longer the clear #1 Country: the IMF October 2026 WEO puts Iraq (19.0%), Qatar (18.8%) and Kuwait (17.1%) ahead of it for 2027 (16.8%), with Sudan 15.0% and Bahrain 13.9% close behind. Six live options, and Country goes late (median R10).
